title: Witherplus
description: a buffed version of the wither and it's drops
body:
This datapack buffs the wither by giving it a new attack and passive, as well as two new drops to make it more worth fighting.

The wither now summons a black hole every minute that deals no damage, but sucks all entities in, as well as constantly summons low health wither skeletons that attack with their fists.

New drops (crafted with nether star) : 
Witherfire (crossbow) : Requires 3 arrows, instead of 1, has a longer charge time, fires wither skulls.
Miniture Black Hole (consumable) : Summon a miniture black hole that sucks all entities in a nearby range in.
